name: Recent shutdown events
description: Events for the selected computers and time range.
kql:
Event
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| where EventLog == "System" and ((EventID == 41 and Source == "Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power") or EventID in (1074, 6006, 6008))
| project Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Computer, Source, EventID, EventLevelName, RenderedDescription,
    Status = case(EventLevel in (1, 2), "Error", EventLevel == 3, "Warning", "Unknown")
| order by Timestamp desc
